subject: Using Plot Builder from R command line

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Using Plot Builder from R command line
parts:
I see hints that the Deducer dialogs can be run from the R command line, and the deducer() command seems to be the way to do this but I've not yet figured out how.

In particular, I want to be able to run the Plot Builder dialog for a given dataset (e.g., iris) and return the ggplot2 commands built that I can then use from the R command line.

Is this possible?

Regards,
Graham

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Using Plot Builder from R command line
parts:
At least on windows, deducer('Plot builder') works for me. The
commands printed/executed in the console. If you want to capture
Deducer commands, override .deducerExecute.

Note that Deducer can not be used from the command line on the mac,
unless perhaps rattle has started R on a non-main thread.

Ian
